blocks.content: Tourism questions on DNH&DD typically test which enclave (Dadra & Nagar Haveli, Daman, or Diu) a given attraction belongs to — a straightforward but easily confused table-based memorisation area given the UT's three-part geography.

blocks.content: ★ EXAM POINT: INS Khukri Memorial, Diu, commemorates the Indian Navy frigate sunk by Pakistan during the 1971 Indo-Pak War — a defence-history fact that crosses over with National/Modern-History General Studies questions well beyond the UT-specific syllabus.

items: Diu's Nagoa and Ghoghla beaches are hubs for water sports (jet-skiing, parasailing, banana-boat rides) given the island's calmer, more sheltered coastline compared to the open-sea beaches of Daman.
Boating at Madhuban Dam and Dudhni Lake are the principal inland/freshwater tourism activities in Dadra & Nagar Haveli.

Toran Mata Temple and Sudhamapuri (associated with ancient Sudama, friend of Lord Krishna, in local tradition) near Porbandar are sometimes conflated with Diu's own religious sites in casual references — candidates should be careful to distinguish DNH&DD's actual sites from nearby Gujarat mainland attractions.
